snippet.title: How visual novels changed my life Trailer
snippet.description:
Trailer for HVNCML, a kinetic that tells the story of our team trying desesperatly to join a game jam called Nanoreno three weeks before it begins. Inspired by actual conversations and actual people, you can now experiment the creation of games...from the inside.
http://traumendes-madchen.com/how-visual-novels-changed-my-life-nanoreno-indie-game/
